description: Checks invoice data against the main EN 16931 rules (required fields, formats, arithmetic, VAT categories) and the particulars German VAT law asks for. It is not a full validator. Returns { ok, findings, totals }: errors block the e-invoice, warnings need a second look, totals are calculated from the lines. The data may be incomplete; what is missing is reported. With pdf_path, values that do not occur in the text of the PDF are reported too. With rules "xrechnung", what XRechnung 3.0 asks for beyond EN 16931 is reported too, under codes that start with "xrechnung-".

invoice.description: Invoice data as printed on the PDF. Copy values exactly; leave out anything the document does not state.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, FR.

name.description: Full legal name of the buyer (the invoice recipient).

vatId.description: VAT identification number of the buyer (the invoice recipient) with country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

buyerReference.description: Reference given by the buyer (Leitweg-ID for German public bodies).

charges.description: Charges such as freight or packaging on the whole invoice as printed, below the lines.

amount.description: Amount. Negative where the lines it applies to add up to a negative amount.

percent.description: Percentage of the lines it applies to, e.g. 5.

vatCategory.description: VAT category it is charged at. Leave out to follow the lines.

vatRate.description: VAT rate in percent it is charged at, e.g. 19. Leave out to follow the lines.

deliveryCountry.description: Country the goods went to, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. State it for an intra-community supply (category K) that did not go to the country of the buyer.

deliveryDate.description: Date of delivery or service. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

discounts.description: Discounts on the whole invoice as printed, below the lines.

amount.description: Amount. Negative where the lines it applies to add up to a negative amount.

percent.description: Percentage of the lines it applies to, e.g. 5.

vatCategory.description: VAT category it is charged at. Leave out to follow the lines.

vatRate.description: VAT rate in percent it is charged at, e.g. 19. Leave out to follow the lines.

discount.description: Discount on this line as printed: a percentage of quantity x unit price, an amount, or both.

amount.description: Discount amount. Negative on a line with a negative quantity.

unit.description: UN/ECE Rec. 20 unit code: C62 piece (default), HUR hour, DAY day, MON month, KGM kilogram, MTR metre, LTR litre, LS lump sum.

unitPrice.description: Net price per unit, without VAT.

vatCategory.description: S standard rate (default), Z zero rated, E exempt, AE reverse charge, K intra-community supply, G export, O not subject to VAT.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms as printed, e.g. "Payable within 14 days".

periodEnd.description: End of the service period. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

periodStart.description: Start of the service period, if a period is given instead of a single date. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

precedingInvoiceDate.description: Date of that earlier invoice. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

precedingInvoiceNumber.description: Number of the invoice this document corrects or cancels.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE, AT, FR.

name.description: Full legal name of the seller (the company that issued the invoice).

taxNumber.description: Local tax number of the seller (German Steuernummer).

vatId.description: VAT identification number of the seller (the company that issued the invoice) with country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

totals.description: Totals exactly as printed on the invoice.

typeCode.description: 380 invoice (default), 381 credit note, 384 corrected invoice, 389 self-billed invoice, 326 partial invoice, 386 prepayment invoice.

vatExemptionReason.description: Printed reason why no VAT is charged (reverse charge, small business, export ...).

invoice.title: Invoice

pdf_path.description: The invoice PDF to compare the data with. Optional. Absolute path.

rules.description: Further rules to check the data against. Optional.

name: check_invoice
title: Check invoice data
